title: When using a grouped animation state machine in an inner blend tree in an outer state machine: _get_parent_playback: "Can't get parent AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback with path: parameters/root_state/aiming/playback. Maybe there is no Root/Nested AnimationNodeStateMachine in the parent of the Grouped AnimationNodeStateMachine."
body: ### Tested versions 4.4.1.stable ### System information Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads) ### Issue description I have an animation tree, with a top level blend tree, a state machine in that blend tree, and a grouped state machine in a blend tree inside of the first state machine. (so blend tree -> state machine in tree -> blend tree as state -> state machine in tree). When I try to use the root playback to travel the grouped state machine, I get the following error: ```E 0:00:06:981 _get_parent_playback: Can't get parent AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback with path: parameters/root_state/aiming/playback. Maybe there is no Root/Nested AnimationNodeStateMachine in the parent of the Grouped AnimationNodeStateMachine. scene/animation/animation_node_state_machine.cpp:1152 @ _get_parent_playback()``` I suspect this is because the inner state machine exists in an inner blend tree, but the documentation for grouped implies this is okay: > This is a grouped state machine that can be controlled from a parent state machine. It does not work independently. There must be a state machine with state_machine_type of STATE_MACHINE_TYPE_ROOT or STATE_MACHINE_TYPE_NESTED in the parent or ancestor. It's possible I'm misunderstanding this documentation and the ancestors all need to be state machines, not a blend tree between state machines. But as written there is an appropriate state machine in the ancestor ### Steps to reproduce It's possible I'm calling the nested state machine wrong, if I make it not a grouped machine I can correctly access the two playbacks via `parameters/root_state/playback` and `parameters/root_state/aiming/aim_state/playback` When grouped I've tried several different strings to no avail. I've tried calling `root.travel("aiming")` -- also `"aiming/aim_state"` & `"aiming/aim_state/RESET"` -- which all generate the error: in addition to several others like `aiming/RESET` which produce useful errors indicating the path is wrong which eventually lead me to believe the paths above are correct and something might be wrong either with my understanding of the documentation or a bug. In the editor, this is the path to the inner state machine: with the inner state machine looking like: and with the inner blend tree looking like: and the outer state machine looking like (this was a bit simpler without pre- and post- nodes until i tried to fix it with the information in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/75759): and finally the outer blend tree just having the state root state machine in it in addition to some oneshots and other branches. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I can try to create an MRP later, but creating these trees is a bit time consuming for me and I suspect I might just be doing something not intended, so I want to make sure that's not the case before I invest in this.
